paragraphs: Chapter 993
Episode 246. The Battle for the Mitra Desert (3)
Sribee, Karmashu, Masalrun.
All but Masalrun of the demons grinned as they glared at Jin and Simart. They now appeared more filled out, with flesh covering what had once looked like skeletal frames.
'The demons are growing stronger at an alarming rate...'
Both Jin and Simart felt this. Fortunately, the demons' 'undissipated' energy couldn't be absorbed.
Sribee specialized in hand-to-hand combat, Karmashu in fire, and Masalrun in curses. Typically, Sribee would press the attack, with Karmashu and Masalrun providing support.
This left Simart feeling somewhat wronged. Since Sribee had decided to attack Simart first, Karmashu and Masalrun naturally targeted Jin less often.
"Alright, being caught is rather annoying. I won't let you catch me now, so play among yourselves."
Red energy surged from Simart's heart. A moment later, it enveloped his whole body, and Jin reflexively began to move.
Swoosh-!
A thrust came in without any warning, so fast that even Jin could hardly follow it with his eyes. As Tetallon grazed Jin's cheek, Sigmund also brushed against his shoulder.
Jin was the first to lose his balance. The red chains and missiles fired by Pivil in response to Simart's attack forced Jin to move again.
'He plans to fight at a speed the demons can't keep up with.'
As Jin thought, Simart began to relentlessly attack, making full use of the wide battlefield.
To the demons, it merely looked like two large balls of light colliding and ricocheting randomly.
With each movement of their swords, sonic booms resonated belatedly, and by the time the ground had collapsed, the two were already gone.
They engaged in a constant battle over a distance of about ten steps, moving at the top speed attainable by the two Celestials. The demons were unable to interfere as easily as before.
However, Pivil matched the pace with precise supporting fire. Amazed by the accuracy, Jin was once again struck by the technical prowess of the Red Myriads.
'If we can't find a way to definitively restrain the air fortress, we can't win against Simart.'
Jin had no choice but to make that judgment.
But if the alliance were to take on the air fortress and expose the home base, the mobility advantage would overwhelmingly favor the Red Myriads.
'The answer in this battle for the desert is to liberate my brethren. Within the long-term battle period that Simart has in mind, we must achieve results.'
In this regard, the sudden appearance of the demons was a boon. As long as Sribee kept his word, the stronger the demons became, the more they would aid Jin, even if just a little.

"In terms of the situation, the probability of Ranke's summoning spell being an unexpected success is high. Looking at the device melting into the magic circle, looking at the moment when the summoning spell succeeded and Kinzelo and his gang were not there, it must be a coincidence that suddenly formed with the massive forces near the equipment.
Ranke's summoning spell summoned demons from a dimension called 'the abyss.'
Jin thought that perhaps the summoning spell could be a clue to the liberation of Lafrarosa.
'When I get back, I must tell Doctor Kwa-ul and Lieutenant Eltiot in detail about what I've learned about the summoning spell. For now, I must keep an eye on Luna Noona while dealing with Shimart.'
"Hee."
Meanwhile, Yona was successfully hidden on the battlefield, watching for an opportunity.
'If that meat called Shimart hadn't momentarily left the battlefield, I might have been caught. Why did that meat leave? Was it pushed by the youngest? That would be good, heehee.'
Yona did not yet know of the summoned demons. She didn't need to. What she had to do was to infiltrate the airborne fortress without being seen by Shimart.
Yona was demonstrating an extraordinary movement that could only be considered miraculous, moving around various parts of the battlefield.
Even those who had reached a superhuman level could not pinpoint Yona's exact location in a battlefield filled with sand dust and shelling like now.
However, the airborne fortress is different. Since the wave of enemy brains is like a sense in itself, anyone exposed to the wave is inevitably caught by the fortress's detection.

'Moving in line with the shelling was definitely right. Hee, both the red fog-like thing and the shelling are brain energy... I'm so smart, when I go back my sister and the youngest will praise me, right?'
Yona did not properly understand the detection ability of the airborne fortress, and it was her first time seeing the wave of enemy brains.

Yet instinctively, she knew that she should not touch the enemy brain wave, and was concealing herself through the pouring shelling. The enemy brain wave filled the desert like air, so it was an inevitable choice for Yona.
'Anyway, it seems that the youngest has tied up the Shimart meat well, so now I must slowly find my sister. Heehee, I love Luna sister.'
Kwagwang, Kwadeuk, Bang...!
With each shelling drop, Yona moved just enough to fit between the gaps. The shelling that the enemy tribe fired to restrain Luna and Eltiot was ironically freeing Yona.
'There she is! I must carefully approach sister so she doesn't get startled...'
Thinking that and approaching Luna, Yona suddenly came face to face with Eltiot, who popped out in front of her.
"He!"
Yona was freshly shocked by Eltiot, who tried to surprise her first. Eltiot was smiling with a playful face, but blood was streaming from his head.
"Sister Master, you're bleeding."
"I came, Yona RunKandel. This is from protecting my disciple."
"Don't talk nonsense, Master. Your body's not what it used to be, so you got hit by the enemy brain wave several times, didn't you?"

Luna greeted Yona with her eyes. Even then, Yona continued to overlap her body between the artillery shots to avoid being detected by the aerial fortress. Even watching her movements directly, Luna could not understand Yona's actions.
"Thud! This rascal, when will you cover up for your master's mistakes? Anyway, you've come at just the right time, Yona. Let's go inside the fortress together."
"How?"

"It's simple. The disciple will break through the fortress's protective shield with an all-out strike, and give a slight blow to the external armor. Meanwhile, I will neutralize the enemy's artillery to create an upward current, and you can ride that current into the fortress."
"Neutralize? Upward current? Hee, don't use difficult words."
"Oh, Yona. These aren't difficult words..."
"Sis, is Master sturdy?"
"What?"
"Sturdy?"
"If I wring out all the energy in my heart to form a shield, it should cover about half of me."
"Hee, okay. Then, after you break the shield, throw Master inside. I'll catch Master as she's thrown and fly up."
"Huh?"
"What are you talking about, Yona?"
"Then all the artillery will focus on Master for a moment, and I'll hide between those shots to enter. I'll cut the external armor myself, heehee."
Yona sneakily showed her cherished sword, Death, as she spoke.
Death was enveloped in a strange ash-colored energy, and Luna realized that it was similar to her own red power. Yona had not been idle after overcoming chaos.
"I don't know how strong the armor is, but that should be enough to cut through it. It might even surpass my Red Moon in cutting power...?"
"Wait, wait. My disciple, Yona, if we do this, Eltieot might die, you know?"
"Yeah, got it!"
"Hey, Yona?"
"I said I got it!"

These were the words of someone who had successfully infiltrated countless times, an assassin among assassins. Luna thought that Yona's proposal would have a higher success rate than Eltieot's method.
"Then, Master, curl up. Like a ball."
Eltieot also thought Yona's way was better. It was only himself who would be in danger.
"Hehe... It's a generation that doesn't know how to respect adults, indeed. Ah, okay, let's do it Yona's way."
As Eltieot curled up, Luna concentrated her mind and drew up her red power. Since it wasn't as urgent as last time, there were no signs of a rampage.
Ka-aaat-!
Luna roared, swinging Crantel, and a giant sword energy that seemed to split the entire desert soared.
The elongated sword energy riding Crantel's blade was so vast that it didn't look like it was thrusting up from the ground into the air, but rather slashing down.
The protective shield of the fortress clashed with the sword energy, spreading a sharp metallic sound, followed by an earthquake throughout the area.
Luna took a deep breath and with all her might, threw Eltieth into the crack of the shield. Eltieth flew like a cannonball.
Luna couldn't precisely perceive the moment Yona caught Eltieth and flew together. Hiding her body between the bombardments, it was simply miraculous that she could do so.
“Block it! Baekgyeong threw Cheongpungje and sent it inside the protective shield!”

The enemy forces also did not recognize Yona. As soon as Eltieth entered the shield, all the fortress's cannons targeted him, and Yona used the enemy cannons as a curtain to cling to the lower armor of the fortress.
The fortress's protective shield was restored in an instant. Trapped inside, Eltieth had no choice but to dodge the indiscriminate bombardment.
“No, wait, just wait! You damned creatures, can't you have some mercy considering our old friendship!? Being thrown by a student, this Eltieth is not even worth mentioning, kek!”
While Eltieth struggled, Yona entered through the armor deepened by Luna's sword energy. With a few swings of her sword, Death, she managed to break through the outer armor.

However, breaking through one layer of armor did not mean she could reach a critical facility immediately. The interior of the air fortress consisted of 7 floors, and it was teeming with enemy warriors and generals.
“An intruder!”
Though it was Yona who broke through the outer armor, exposure was inevitable. The enemies quickly surrounded Yona, glaring at her.
When one warrior pressed a protruding button on the wall, enemy brainwaves also spread. Already surrounded, and with the brainwaves present, Yona had no choice but to make a head-on breakthrough.
But Yona had foreseen this situation from the beginning.
“Red meats. You all better watch your feet.”
“What nonsense...”

The Grade 1 general, trying to respond to Yona, could not finish his words. Suddenly, a huge sword energy, like what Luna had just shot, tore through the lower armor of the fortress, spreading blue brainwaves inside.
“Choke!”
“Gasp!”
The blue brainwaves spreading inside the fortress instantly incapacitated most of the enemies, like flames thrown among insects. Only the general-level enemies managed to withstand it.
It was Jin's sword energy, accurately reading Luna's situation while fighting Shimat.
However, Jin paid a price. In the struggle to fend off Shimat and hastily shoot the sword energy, she deeply cut her arm on Tetallon.
“Heh, I knew the youngest and I were a good match.”
Yona's eyes sparkled as she looked at the remaining generals. The general in front, thinking her eyes were chilling, met his end as his head fell off.
